notes: A security release plus new embeds. Security: the OIDC callback now binds every SSO flow to the browser that started it (GHSA-5gx8-3hch-6m2f), closing an account-linking CSRF that could hand a logged-in victim's account, admin included, to an attacker through their own IdP identity; instances with SSO configured should update promptly. New embeds: Dailymotion, Twitch, Rumble and GitHub repo cards join YouTube, Spotify, Vimeo, SoundCloud and Bandcamp, and unknown embed URLs now render as clickable cards instead of disappearing. Also fixes Rich-preview Open Graph truncation at apostrophes and a dependency group bump.
